facts.text: PostFacts throws ArgumentException when request.Subject is null, before the connection and transaction are opened for the batch.
An item that is null adds a PostError with code missing_fact and the message fact[index] is null, then the loop moves to the next item.
A fact whose Kind is null or whitespace is rejected with error code missing_kind before the text and local_id checks run.
A fact whose Text is null is rejected with error code missing_text and the item is skipped.
A local_id repeated inside the same batch is rejected with duplicate_local_id and the later item is skipped.
MissingSupersedesTarget queries the facts table for each supersedes ref of kind fact and rejects the item as supersedes_target_not_found when one is absent.
The content hash is computed with ContentHash.Compute over the already resolved refs, so a ref written as @x hashes as the fact id it points at.
When a keyed slot exists and SlotOccupantIsIdentical is true the result is deduped, DuplicateOf is the existing id, and no new fact row is written.
On the replaced path the code inserts the new fact, repoints the slot with PointSlotAt, then sets the old fact status to superseded.
at: PointSlotAt(connection, transaction, subject.Id, fact.Kind, fact.Key!, id)

facts.text: FindLiveFactByHash selects the first live fact matching subject, kind, key and content_hash, ordered by rowid with LIMIT 1.
With DryRun set the transaction is rolled back, so the subject, facts, refs and slot writes are all discarded.
PruneChanges runs only on the commit path, immediately before transaction.Commit().
InsertFact writes status live, defaults confidence to 1.0 when absent, and stamps provenance from the writer identity and createdAt.
InsertFact adds a facts_fts row keyed by last_insert_rowid() with the fact text and its tags joined by a space.
Each ref is inserted with seq taken from reference.Seq, falling back to its position in the resolved list.
InsertFact skips an attachment whose Sha256 is null or whitespace, and INSERT OR REPLACE means a repeated sha256 keeps its last entry.
Compute builds the hash input as normalized text, a newline, the canonical JSON of data when data is present, then a newline.
Each ref line is formatted from rel, kind, target and LocatorMin, then the lines are ordered with StringComparer.Ordinal before joining.
The final digest is SHA256 over the UTF8 bytes of that string, converted to hex and lowercased.
LocatorMin returns an empty string when the locator has no value, otherwise CanonicalJson.Write of the locator.
Write creates a StringBuilder, appends the element recursively, and returns the built string.
Object properties are enumerated in ordinal name order, with a comma written before every property after the first.
A number value is written with GetRawText so its original formatting is preserved.
Names.Normalize returns the empty string when the value is null or whitespace, before any lowercasing.
PostFacts.cs declares NoRefs as one shared empty List of RefInput, used when a fact carries no refs.
at: private static readonly List<RefInput> NoRefs = new();

facts.text: ApplySupersedes only updates a target row whose status is not superseded or retracted, so an already closed target writes nothing.
When that update changes no row, ApplySupersedes continues and leaves the target's slot row untouched.
A correction ref whose target equals the fact being written is skipped, so a fact cannot supersede itself.
Once a target flips to superseded, ApplySupersedes deletes every slots row whose fact_id is that target.
A ref whose Rel is null or whitespace is rejected as missing_rel before Kind, Target and Basis are checked.
A ref whose Kind is empty is rejected as missing_ref_kind, a code distinct from the fact-level missing_kind.
A ref whose Target is empty is rejected as missing_target.
A ref whose Basis is empty is rejected as missing_basis.
For kind symbol the revision is everything after the last @, and a target with nothing after that @ is rejected as symbol_target_requires_revision.
A target starting with @ is replaced by the earlier fact id registered under that local_id, and an unknown local_id yields unresolved_local_id.
A ref of kind slot bypasses the @ local_id rewrite and is stored with its target verbatim.
When an id is supplied without a name and no subject has that id, UpsertSubject throws DossierRequestException with code subject_not_found rather than creating a subject.
An existing subject is matched when its normalized name or any normalized alias equals the normalized requested name.
The subjects row is updated only when the informative aliases or the parent differ, so an identical repost does not bump the revision.
An alias equal to the subject's own name is not informative and is excluded from that comparison.
A new subject gets a Guid formatted D as its id and the requested name trimmed before insertion.
ReadSubjects returns subjects ordered by created_at then id, so the first matching row wins.
SlotOccupantIsIdentical compares content_hash, requires the occupant status to be live, and compares the serialized tags, confidence and items.
at: SELECT content_hash, status, tags, confidence, items FROM facts WHERE id = $id

facts.text: Ref comparison also covers basis, confidence, rev, snapshot, snapshot_hash, etag, verified_at and valid, which the hash ignores.
An input ref without a seq is compared at its index, and the wanted refs are sorted by that effective seq.
Attachments are compared by sha256 key, filename, mime, bytes and perceptual, and a differing count short-circuits to false.
SetFactStatus adds status != $status to the update so a no-op write does not fire trg_facts_update.
at: UPDATE facts SET status = $status WHERE id = $id AND status != $status

facts.text: PointSlotAt upserts on the slots key subject_id, kind and key, overwriting fact_id with excluded.fact_id.
at: ON CONFLICT(subject_id, kind, key) DO UPDATE SET fact_id = excluded.fact_id

facts.text: FindSlotFactId reads fact_id from slots by subject_id, kind and key and returns null when no row matches.
at: SELECT fact_id FROM slots WHERE subject_id = $subject AND kind = $kind AND key = $key

facts.text: MergeAliases dedupes by normalized alias using an ordinal HashSet and appends the subject name last.
MergeAliases keeps the trimmed original spelling of the first alias seen for each normalized form and drops empty aliases.
WriterIdentity.Cli is the default writer with actor dossier-cli, channel cli and actor type tool.
